reviews.title: No free trial
reviews.text:
I signed up for the free trial expecting that I would not be charged during the trial period. However, I was charged for the subscription before the trial ended. I canceled the subscription only a few days after purchasing it and submitted a refund request to Apple, but the refund was denied.

I understand that subscription terms can vary, but charging users during what they understood to be a free trial is extremely frustrating. Now I’m left with a debt for an app that I have not used and will no be using because it does not fit my needs. 

I’m very disappointed with this experience and would not recommend the app because of the way this situation was handled.

reviews.title: I used to love this app
reviews.text:
I used to love this app and have been using it regularly, but ever since the recent updates, I’ve noticed several issues starting to pop up — one of the biggest being with how weights are displayed.

When I enter my workout weights in pounds, the app now converts and shows them as long decimal numbers instead of clean, rounded figures. For example, if I type in 45 lbs, it shows something like “20.41164 lbs” or “36.28736 lbs.” It seems like the app might be converting entries to kilograms internally and then re-displaying them incorrectly.

This makes tracking confusing and really takes away from the otherwise smooth experience the app used to offer. I’ve double-checked my unit settings, and they’re definitely set to pounds.

Please look into fixing this issue — I’d really like to keep using Planfit the way I used to enjoy it.

reviews.title: Helpful app, but…
reviews.text: I actually really enjoy this app as it has helped me maintain a good routine as well as tracking progress. The problem is that a lot of other useful features are locked behind a premium paywall. I should not have to pay a subscription fee for wanting to exclude certain exercises from plans. Also there needs to be an option to copy/paste routines to planned days.

reviews.title: Language choices
reviews.text: The app has really helped me to focus. I love that you just tell it what equipment you have and let it generate a plan even in the free version. I will probably bump up to the paid version soon because I’m starting to see real results. My ONLY complaint is that in the “instructions” part of some of the exercises that I have clicked into to make sure I’m doing them right, they are written in a language that I can’t read. I’ve went through all the setting screens to see if maybe I had something set wrong but I don’t see an option to change languages. Other than that, this is a wonderful app. Thank you!
